functions.notes: Pragma-free ceiling. The ROM duplicates the add sp/pop epilogue at every return (inline addeq/popeq, add sp; mov r0,#0; pop). With a sub-sp frame this mwcc build funnels all returns to one shared epilogue (mov r0,#0; b) unless #pragma optimize_for_size off is present, which the rules and wgate forbid; same cause as deadends 0221c5ac. Neighbour 020be09c (AllocateAndFillListEntry020be09c) uses that pragma. Struct-based rewrite with 'if (mode != 2) return 1;' reached 0x260 vs 0x270 (copy at /tmp/c2330-5/c.cpp); toy compiles confirm every frame function funnels regardless of return type, nesting, result variable or comma-return. colorsweep --apply did not help. 15 gate runs used.
